authorization.decision: Approved reuse of voice assets lawfully owned or licensed by EKODI across all EKODI products and sites. No repeated operator approvals needed for the same authorized asset.

scope.permissionModel: single documented grant per eligible speaker/recording, reusable across tenant sites without further owner confirmation

releaseRule: Owner approval controls EKODI operational use; it does not impersonate an unrelated speaker or bypass protected content and model-license checks.
